principles.statement: Project workflow state lives in .go/ next to code.
principles.rationale: A fresh clone should explain current direction and next work.

principles.statement: Current state is JSON and append-only history is JSONL.
Every autonomous go run must define or repair the end goal, acceptance, verification, and task boundary before implementation.
principles.rationale: Autonomy without an explicit goal becomes random feature generation.
principles.enforcement: router/preflight blocks or repairs missing vision, principles, hierarchy, and executable task state

principles.statement: A bare go on a valid .go repo starts the agent command train instead of returning micro-commands for Viggo to run.
principles.rationale: Viggo should provide direction, not repeatedly trigger next/claim/recheck/devil/finish phases.
principles.enforcement: Hermes skill and CLI handoff require immediate tool execution until done, blocker, or budget

principles.statement: A task is not done at first passing verification; recheck/devil/critic and repair/self-reflect must run for non-trivial work.
principles.rationale: Viggo consistently finds gaps after recheck/selfimprove, so the loop must internalize that review stack.
principles.enforcement: loop conductor requires critic verdict before finish for code/docs/contracts/public behavior

principles.statement: The go loop defaults to solo or lead-plus-one-worker; parallel builders require disjoint modify scopes and a reviewer lane, while overlapping modify scopes remain serial.
principles.rationale: More agents can increase context burn, file collisions, and false progress unless capacity and review are explicit.
principles.enforcement: auto/go-loop handoff exposes execution_policy.capacity and regression tests cover solo, serial-review, and disjoint-parallel cases

principles.statement: Planned: de runner beheert de volledige release en sluit de taak pas na het vereiste bewijs.
principles.rationale: Model-success en lokaal afgerond werk bewijzen geen gepubliceerde versie.
principles.enforcement: abc-05 v0.3.21 enforces content-bound checks, critic, requirements and release readback on opted-in finish/approval/reporting. Automatic publication and deployment remain abc-06/07.

principles.statement: Planned: model, effort en effectieve runtime-instellingen zijn expliciet en blijven behouden bij hervatten.
principles.rationale: Voorkomt metadata zonder effect en stille modelwissels.
principles.enforcement: abc-01/02 shipped opt-in profiles and native model arguments/capability checks/frozen selection; abc-04 v0.3.19 retains profiles through exclusive phase resume. Effective identity remains unconfirmed.

principles.statement: Planned: voortgang en verifieerbare contextsnapshots leven in .go; workers kunnen op veilige grenzen worden vervangen.
principles.rationale: Overdracht en herstel mogen niet afhankelijk zijn van één levende chat.
principles.enforcement: abc-03 shipped immutable context in v0.3.18; abc-04 shipped exclusive phase resume and local relocation in v0.3.19. Live topology proof remains abc-09/10.

principles.statement: Planned: één branch/worktree per taak met gevalideerde identiteit, scope en exclusief schrijverschap; modelwissels behouden de werkplek.
principles.rationale: Voorkomt gebruikerswerkverlies, dubbele workers en losse worktreequeues.
principles.enforcement: abc-11 v0.3.17 owned workspace primitives, abc-03 v0.3.18 durable worker context and abc-04 v0.3.19 exclusive resume/local relocation shipped. Template orchestration remains template-01/02.

principles.statement: Planned: fasebewijs is getypeerd en aan geteste inhoud gebonden; integratie of versievoorbereiding invalideert getroffen checks.
principles.rationale: Veld-aanwezigheid en groen vóór rebase bewijzen geen correcte release.
principles.enforcement: abc-01 typed phase contracts and abc-05 v0.3.21 executed raw command evidence/content binding shipped. Version/integration orchestration and full end-to-end proof remain abc-06/10.

principles.statement: Planned: vertaal relevante fasecontracten en regressies; laad skills naar taak/risico en behoud de verplichte lifecycle.
principles.rationale: Behoud oude garanties zonder de monolithische runtime of ongewenste automatisering terug te brengen.
principles.enforcement: abc-01/03/05 reuse phase contracts, selective context and legacy push-fail/finish-before-ship regressions. Broader migration and end-to-end proof remain abc-08/10.
